svg.aria-label: DELOS architecture: training with node and future masking in latent space, and inference with a probe head
svg.text: Self-supervised training on one window of H history + P future snapshots
X, A for t−3 … t only
– marked rows: the M masked nodes,
history hidden for t ≥ 1; first step
stays visible as the identity anchor.
token(t, i) = latent or mask token
Ẑ = g(Z), all (t, i) at once
‖Ẑ − Z̄‖² averaged over active nodes at
Masking (node_mask scheme): M nodes are drawn per step, shared across the batch; their latents at t ≥ 1 and every node's future latents are replaced by one learned mask token.
Optional variants in the code: hide the M nodes from the context encoder's input too (--mask_encoder_input), residual head Ẑ = anchor + g(·), EMA / VICReg / SIGReg targets, edge-mask head.
Inference and downstream readout (predictor and encoder frozen; only the head sees labels)
no node masks; future = mask tokens
Trained predictor is reloaded from the best-validation checkpoint; the head is then fit on train windows and scored on the chronological test split.
Intervention: passing a node set as do(·) replaces those nodes' history with mask tokens at inference, giving counterfactual forecasts for the others.
Fine-tune protocol (finetune_state.py): same pieces, but f, g and h are trained end-to-end on labels, optionally with the JEPA loss as an auxiliary term.
